Now I want to check api-translation.ts, the AI adapter, to see how it handles spawning processes, retries, and concurrency.

I found the root cause: spawnPrompt is called without a timeoutMs, so a hung copilot CLI process blocks forever, even though the function signature already supports that parameter. I'm also checking the copilot wrapper script, since it reads all of stdin before invoking the CLI, and wondering if copilot itself might still wait for interactive input despite the node side closing stdin after writing the prompt.

The best fix is adding a configurable timeout to the AI adapter's spawn so stalled chunks fail and can be retried instead of hanging indefinitely, plus redirecting copilot's stdin from /dev/null in the wrapper so it can never block on interactive input. I should check whether there's already a precedent for a timeout env var elsewhere, like in the i18n pipeline.

I'm considering adding a timeout to the runClaude call, likely via an environment variable like DOCS_TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT_MS with a sensible default, plus hardening the wrapper by redirecting stdin from /dev/null. data.content:
The hang wasn't language-specific — `ga` just happened to be where the Copilot CLI wedged. `AiTranslationAdapter.runClaude` called `spawnPrompt` with no timeout, so a child that never exits blocked the chunk (and, at concurrency 4, quickly the whole run) forever with no output.

Changes:
- [docs/scripts/api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts) — pass `timeoutMs` (env `DOCS_TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 120000) to `spawnPrompt`. `translateBatch` already logs and skips a failed chunk, so a timed-out batch is left uncached and retried next run instead of stalling.
- [tools/translation-adapters/copilot-wrapper.sh](tools/translation-adapters/copilot-wrapper.sh) and [tools/translation-adapters/agy-wrapper.sh](tools/translation-adapters/agy-wrapper.sh) — run the CLI with `</dev/null` so it can't block on an interactive prompt.
- Documented the knob in [docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md](docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md) plus a changeset.

Tests pass (141). Re-run your command; if a call wedges you'll now see `! skipped a batch of N strings: AI command timed out…` and the run continues.
